experimental_method: Synthetic (bubble-point) method in a Cailletet apparatus: a sample of known overall composition is pressurised at fixed temperature until the vapour phase just disappears.
uncertainties_stated: Pressure balance accuracy 0.005 MPa; Pt100 thermometer accuracy 0.01 K; weighing 0.0001 g; CO2 dosing pressure error 0.01 cm Hg, temperature error 0.1 K; composition uncertainties printed per block (x +- 0.00003 to 0.00005; molality +- 0.000016 to 0.000018).
quality_remarks: Authors report a systematic overpressure of about 1 MPa for the 1 mol/kg Na2SO4 bubble points relative to some literature data (Rumpf and Maurer 1993) with relative average deviation 13.6%; CO2-water agrees with literature (3.4%). Text says Tables 1-5 but 'Table 2 approx. 1 mol/kg' has two slightly different molalities (0.996313, 0.995676). Temperatures range 286.97-369.65 K. Na2SO4 prepared from Na2SO4.10H2O.
not_extracted_tables: Table 6 (CO2 EOS coefficients), Table 7, Table 8 (binary parameter coefficients): model parameters
